title: Surreal Time and Decay
description: A surreal spiral composition features a giant cracked baby head with glowing orange eyes and blue tears, a green robot head above it, and the Grim Reaper in a purple cloak holding a clock-faced beetle. In the lower right, an elderly couple sits at a dining table with a green creature on a plate, surrounded by skulls, clocks, and melting elements against a swirling cosmic background.
